! Game text
| '''0 side — Zero Hour'''<br />Deploy Lothal system and a Lothal site. For remainder of game, Menace Fades and Projection Of A Skywalker are canceled. Jedi (except Ahsoka and Kanan), Resistance characters, and [Resistance] starships are deploy +1. Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine, and Zeb gain Phoenix Squadron. Once per turn, may ▼ a Lothal site. Flip this card if Rebels control three Lothal locations (or you occupy three Lothal locations with Phoenix Squadron characters) and opponent controls no Lothal locations.<br />'''7 side — Liberation Of Lothal'''<br />While this side up, if you Force drained at a battleground this turn, your other Force drains at battlegrounds are +1. Once per turn, may add or subtract X from a just drawn battle destiny (or opponent's weapon destiny), where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy with Phoenix Squadron characters. At Lothal system, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited for either player. Flip this card if opponent controls more Lothal locations than you. || '''0 side — Zero Hour'''<br />Deploy Lothal system and a Lothal site. For remainder of game, Menace Fades and Projection Of A Skywalker are canceled. Jedi (except Ahsoka and Kanan), Resistance characters, and [Resistance] starships are deploy +1. Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine, and Zeb gain Phoenix Squadron. Once per turn, may ▼ a Lothal site. Flip this card if Rebels control three Lothal locations (or you occupy three Lothal locations with Phoenix Squadron characters) and opponent controls no Lothal locations.<br />'''7 side — Liberation Of Lothal'''<br />While this side up, if you Force drained at a battleground this turn, your other Force drains at battlegrounds are +1. Once per turn {{Errata hl|1=during battle}}, may add or subtract X from a just drawn battle destiny (or opponent's weapon destiny), where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy with Phoenix Squadron characters. At Lothal system, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited for either player. Flip this card if opponent controls more Lothal locations than you. || '''0 side — Zero Hour'''<br />Deploy Lothal system and a Lothal site. For remainder of game, Menace Fades and Projection Of A Skywalker are canceled. {{Errata hl|1=Harc,}} Jedi (except Ahsoka and Kanan), and {{Errata hl|1=your [Episode I] (and [Episode VII]) cards with ability}} are deploy {{Errata hl|1=+2}}. Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine, and Zeb gain Phoenix Squadron. Once per turn, may ▼ a Lothal site. Flip this card if Rebels control three Lothal locations (or you occupy three Lothal locations with Phoenix Squadron characters) and opponent controls no Lothal locations.<br />'''7 side — Liberation Of Lothal'''<br />While this side up, if you Force drained at a battleground this turn, your other Force drains at battlegrounds are +1. Once per turn during battle, may add or subtract X from a just drawn battle destiny (or opponent's weapon destiny), where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy with Phoenix Squadron characters. At Lothal system, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited for either player. Flip this card if opponent controls more Lothal locations than you.
